channel.title: Trail Tater Campfire
channel.description: Trail Tater campground trips, family adventures, camp cooking, history, and stories from along the way.

item.title: Nine more Trail Tater Kitchen recipes
item.description: The Trail Tater Kitchen just got a lot bigger: Lost River Mountain Breakfast, two different breakfast potato recipes, Walker Brook Mexicorn, Old Man of the Mountain Biscuits, gluten-free biscuits, Butt Crack Fudge, Dutch Oven Pulled Pork and Percolated Camp Coffee now have their own mobile-friendly recipe pages.

item.title: Trail Tater Kitchen is open
item.description: Pull up a chair and grab a plate. Trail Tater Kitchen is now open with campground-tested recipes, Blackstone meals, camp breakfasts and the first full recipe: Trail Tater Steak and Cheese Burritos. Printable recipe PDFs will be added to recipe pages as the cookbook library grows.

item.title: Meet the Trail Tater Crew
item.description: Meet Campfire Ken, Lisa, Billie, Stewie, the wider Adventure Crew, and our friend Abe. Trail Tater is family camping, road trips, history, food, campground stories, and the people who make the miles worth remembering.

item.title: Lost River 2027: The Return
item.description: The new Lost River 2027 page is live. Trail Tater is heading back to Lost River Valley Campground in North Woodstock, New Hampshire, July 28 through August 3, 2027, with a bigger family crew, three home bases, camp cooking, river time, and another round at Clark’s Bears. Pull up a chair and preview the return trip.

item.title: Trail Tater is on YouTube
item.description: Trail Tater has a new YouTube home and a fresh look. The new channel brings campground stories, family adventures, camp cooking, history, old cemeteries, amateur radio, and the next generation of Trail Tater—including Billie and Kalley—onto video. Pull up a chair and meet us at @TrailTater.

item.title: Back to Lost River Valley Campground in 2027
item.description: Trail Tater is planning a return to Lost River Valley Campground in North Woodstock, New Hampshire, July 28 through August 3, 2027.
